records.name: Voss Null
records.biography_en: Voss Null serves with Silent Detail, a black ops detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The short black open-face cowl is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Voss Null looks coldly attentive even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
